en.t: "You are far too childish. Do not be so unwilling to lose."

units.source_text: "我想让你知道，认识是能够使这个世界变形的。

en.t: "I want you to understand that perception can deform this world.

units.source_text: 其他任何东西都不能改变任何一个世界。

en.t: Nothing else can change any world at all.

units.source_text: 只有认识，才能使世界在不变的情况下，在原来的状态下变形。

en.t: Only perception can deform the world while leaving it unchanged, still in its original state.

units.source_text: 从认识的眼光来看，世界是永久不变的，而且也是永久变形的。

en.t: Seen through the eyes of perception, the world is eternally unchanged, and also eternally deformed.

units.source_text: 也许你会说这又有什么用呢。

en.t: Perhaps you will ask what use that could possibly be.

units.source_text: 但是可以说，为了能够忍受这种生，人类掌握认识的武器。

en.t: But one may say that in order to endure this kind of life, human beings took up the weapon of perception.

units.source_text: 动物就不需要这种玩艺儿，因为动物没有什么忍受生的意识啊。

en.t: Animals have no need for such a thing, because animals have no consciousness of enduring life.

units.source_text: 认识就是生的忍受性原封不动地变成人类的武器。

en.t: Perception is the endurance of life transformed, just as it is, into a human weapon.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，那种忍受性丝毫也未能减轻。

en.t: Even so, that endurance has not been lightened in the slightest.
